purpose: Teach: 長田/井口/小西/宮澤/田辺/塩川/児玉/本間

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 長田部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome reception for Director Nagata organized.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Clear directive without urgency. Brisk opening, steady pace. The tone of someone running through a list she's already mentally mapped.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。井口課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check Manager Iguchi's handover notes.
lines.style: Quick confirmation, ready to move. Light and cooperative without overselling the agreement. The ease of someone who knows their role and steps into it naturally.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小西技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project status from Technical Lead Konishi.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. A slight lift on 「共有」 — inviting input, not just downloading information. Clear and purposeful without hierarchy-flex.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。宮澤広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll confirm the monthly plan from PR—Miyazawa.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Slightly slower pace than the previous confirmation—detail-oriented, checking as he speaks. Warm but focused.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 田辺顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a meeting with Advisor Tanabe.
lines.style: Measured directive. A touch more weight on this one—slightly longer pause before saying it, like it matters. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。塩川経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the fiscal closing timeline from Accounting—Shiokawa.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation. Efficient, no wasted words. Moving through the list with practiced ease. Slight check-off quality on the ending.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 児玉人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's request a new-hire training plan from HR—Kodama.
lines.style: Clear direction. A touch of care on this one—new-hire training is about people. Not demanding, asking. Steady and purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本間法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask Legal—Homma to review the new contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight sense of completion in the pacing. Clean, committed finish. The last checkbox ticked with quiet satisfaction.
